title: Length, Weight, Capacity and Time
summary: Kilometres and metres, kilograms and grams, litres and millilitres, and hours, minutes and seconds.

cbse.chapter: Maths Mela (2025) Ch 5: Far and Near
Maths Mela (2025) Ch 8: Weight and Capacity

objectives: I can convert between units of length, weight and capacity.
I can convert between hours, minutes and seconds.
I can choose a sensible unit.
misconceptions: A bigger number always means a bigger amount, whatever the unit.
1 kg of cotton is lighter than 1 kg of iron.
